covers: Ruff formatter off or skip markers

performance.notes: Set path-specific latency budgets per application.

pr_gates.requirement: Unit tests with at least 90% line coverage and 80% branch coverage.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Backend and frontend enforce 90% line coverage plus 80% branch coverage; frontend also enforces 80% statement and function coverage.

pr_gates.requirement: Integration coverage for all declared integration boundaries.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run the backend API and processing integration suites as a dedicated gate.

pr_gates.requirement: Real FFmpeg exports must decode fully and preserve subtitle geometry across the supported media matrix.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run the deterministic real-media compatibility and golden-frame export gate.

pr_gates.requirement: Acceptance or E2E coverage for critical flows.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Add or confirm Playwright or equivalent acceptance coverage after human review of critical flows.
Run the repo-local architecture checker for cross-stack leaks and import cycles.

pr_gates.requirement: No new or worsened complexity and function-size hotspots across Python, TypeScript, and Java.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run the cross-language Lizard ratchet at cyclomatic complexity 10 and NLOC 50.

pr_gates.requirement: Every Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Java function must have cognitive complexity at most 15.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run language-native cognitive analysis separately from the Lizard cyclomatic metric.

pr_gates.requirement: Duplicated lines must not exceed 3% across production code and tests.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run jscpd across Python, frontend, Java, SQL, CSS, and shell sources.

pr_gates.requirement: Every tracked or new non-ignored hand-written code file must contain at most 700 physical lines, including legacy code and tests.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run the repository-owned file-length checker across tracked and new non-ignored code with no grandfathered baseline.

pr_gates.requirement: Python must match Ruff format and supported frontend/web files must match Prettier.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run the pinned formatter check; use `make format` to apply the canonical output.

pr_gates.requirement: Zero critical or blocker static-analysis issues.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run strict mypy, Ruff, ESLint, dead-code analysis, and frontend TypeScript type-checking.

pr_gates.requirement: Zero high or critical security issues.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run Bandit, backend dependency audit in an isolated venv, and frontend npm audit.

pr_gates.requirement: The Java/Spring migration surface must build and pass unit, integration, and coverage checks under JDK 25.
pr_gates.suggested_command: Run a clean Maven verify against an isolated temporary PostgreSQL database through the JDK 25 resolver.

nightly_gates.requirement: Mutation kill rate above 95% for critical logic or the full repo where practical.
nightly_gates.suggested_command: Run PIT against the Java authentication and request-safety boundary under the nightly JDK 25 workflow.

nightly_gates.requirement: No more than 10% degradation on critical paths.
nightly_gates.suggested_command: Run the deterministic subtitle export performance smoke gate.

nightly_gates.requirement: No high or critical DAST findings on the deployable surface.
nightly_gates.suggested_command: Run OWASP ZAP only after a deployable preview target exists.

notes: Acceptance flows remain human-owned and should be confirmed in .codex/acceptance-flows.md.
Complexity and function-size regressions are blocked across Python, TypeScript, and Java with a reviewed baseline ratchet.
Cognitive complexity, duplicate-code percentage, canonical formatting, and the 700-line file maximum are independent hard gates without legacy exemptions.
CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency-diff review, and production-image build/vulnerability scans run as dedicated GitHub workflows.
Real-media export compatibility and golden-frame regression checks run locally without external providers.
Java/Spring enforcement is executable through check:java and CI configures JDK 25 plus PostgreSQL; local runs require both services.
Java PIT mutation testing covers the authentication and request-safety boundary; subtitle export performance smoke is also executable nightly.
DAST remains blocked until the repo has a stable deployable preview target for OWASP ZAP.

check:format.shell: ruff format --check . && cd frontend && npm run format:check

check:static.shell: mypy backend/app .codex/scripts/run_isolated_quality_gate.py .codex/scripts/check_coverage_thresholds.py .codex/scripts/check_code_complexity.py .codex/scripts/check_file_length.py .codex/scripts/check_quality_suppressions.py && ruff check backend .codex/scripts/run_isolated_quality_gate.py .codex/scripts/check_coverage_thresholds.py .codex/scripts/check_code_complexity.py .codex/scripts/check_file_length.py .codex/scripts/check_quality_suppressions.py && find .codex/scripts deploy/hetzner -type f -name '*.sh' -exec shellcheck {} + && cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run lint:dead-code && npx tsc --noEmit

check:cognitive:python.shell: set -o pipefail; git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard '*.py' '*.pyi' | xargs -0 complexipy

check:unit:backend.shell: cd backend && APP_ENV=dev pytest -m 'not media_export' && python3 ../.codex/scripts/check_coverage_thresholds.py .coverage.json --lines 90 --branches 80

check:e2e.shell: cd frontend && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=31873 npm run e2e

check:integration.shell: cd backend && APP_ENV=dev pytest -o addopts='' tests/test_auth.py tests/test_jobs_and_videos.py tests/test_export_route_regressions.py tests/test_processing_task_helpers.py tests/test_validation_helpers.py tests/test_gdpr.py tests/test_retention.py tests/test_security.py

check:media-export.shell: cd backend && APP_ENV=dev GSP_MOCK_EXTERNAL_SERVICES=1 GSP_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD=0 GSP_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_PER_REQUEST_BUDGET_USD=0 pytest -o addopts='' -m media_export tests/test_real_media_exports.py

check:dast.message: DAST requires a stable deployable preview URL; no ZAP target is configured for this local-first repo yet.
